_description: Metadata sidecar for the dashboard's CLI section. Joined against package.json scripts by scripts/lib/dashboard/collect-cli.mjs. Missing entries surface as 'uncatalogued' — that's intentional friction so new scripts get a description added here. Categories: audit, diagnostic, sync, skills, arch, security, learning, plans, dashboard, hooks, parity, test, other.

anthropic:ping.description: One-shot Anthropic API ping (verifies the configured backend — sdk or cli).

arch:coverage-gate.description: Gate on observed-graph coverage: fails when the import graph is too lossy to be an authority. Runs downstream of arch:render so it can never abort the dashboard build.

arch:drift.description: Detect drift between code and the architectural memory snapshot.

arch:duplicates.description: Find near-duplicate symbols across the repo (cosine similarity).

arch:prune.description: Prune stale entries from the architectural memory snapshot.

arch:refresh.description: Refresh architectural-memory: extract symbols, embed, index in Supabase (changed files only).

arch:refresh:full.description: Full architectural-memory refresh — re-index every symbol (expensive).

arch:render.description: Render docs/architecture-map.md from the symbol index.

arch:spike.description: One-off spike-extract: experimental symbol extraction without indexing.

audit.description: Run /audit-loop — dispatches to /audit-plan or /audit-code by input shape.

audit-exp:harvest.description: Phase 2 of the audit-effectiveness experiment — mine git commit→fix pairs into candidate known-buggy commits (real ground truth) for human curation.

audit-exp:ledger.description: Phase 1 of the audit-effectiveness experiment — read-only ledger decomposition (accepted value by round/stage + gate marginal value); a free kill-criterion diagnostic.

audit:bandit.description: Print Thompson Sampling Beta posteriors per audit prompt variant.

audit:check-deps.description: Verify audit-loop runtime deps are installed.

audit:clean.description: Age-gated, allowlist-only pruning of transient .audit/ + worksheet working files (dry-run).

audit:clean:apply.description: audit:clean with deletion applied (transient files older than 14d; keep-list guarded).

audit:code.description: Multi-pass code audit (structure / wiring / backend / frontend / sustainability).

audit:full.description: Full multi-round audit with deliberation + Gemini final review.

audit:gemini-ping.description: One-shot Gemini API ping (verifies GEMINI_API_KEY + model resolution).

audit:gemini-review.description: Gemini 3.1 Pro final review of the Claude+GPT audit transcript.

audit:phase7.description: Pre-flight check that Step 7 (Gemini final review) prerequisites are met.

audit:plan.description: GPT-5.4 plan audit pass (use --mode plan; max 3 rounds).

audit:rebuttal.description: GPT deliberation pass on Claude's rebuttal of findings.

audit:refine.description: LLM-driven prompt refinement from outcome data.

audit:sync-shared-refs.description: Sync shared references (audit-loop docs) into skill files.

audit:tiered-shadow-report.description: Summarize the tiered-recall pipeline's shadow-validation log (Close-out) — cost/latency deltas, finding overlap, ahead of the Phase 14 production-flip decision.

audit:tiered-shadow-report:json.description: Tiered-pipeline shadow-validation summary, JSON output (for CI).

audit:wtf.description: Friction log — capture a 'what happened, what hurt' note for later review.

azure:doctor.description: Probe + verify the Azure embedding deployment, then confirm and lock it into .env (--fix).

azure:limits.description: Probe each Azure deployment and print its live TPM/RPM rate limits + reset windows.

cache:check:json.description: Cache hit-rate diagnostic, JSON output (for CI).

check.description: Combined gate: context drift + skills cross-check + full test suite.

check:integration.description: Opt-in end-to-end smoke: arch:refresh:full + migration-drift check against the active repo + Postgres (NOT part of npm test). Requires AUDIT_DB_URL; both halves short-circuit gracefully when unset.

cli:flags.description: Census of every flag-parsing CLI and whether it REJECTS unknown flags (via assertKnownFlags or its own diagnostic). Report-only.

cli:flags:gate.description: The DRIFT-gate form of cli:flags (part of `npm run check`): fails only on a NET-NEW CLI that parses flags but ignores unknown ones. The 24 pre-existing ones are baselined so the gate is a ratchet, not a wall. Origin: refresh.mjs --full --dry-run silently discarded --dry-run and ran a real full refresh.

context:check.description: Detect drift between CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md and the live codebase.

context:check:sarif.description: Context-drift check, SARIF output (for GitHub code-scanning).

context:staleness.description: Report AGENTS.md lines whose cited code has moved since the line did. A REPORT, never a gate — drift is a smell, not a verdict.

context:staleness:json.description: context:staleness as JSON, for the weekly maintenance replica.

dashboard.description: Build the dashboard, then serve it on a localhost port (default 4173).

dashboard:audit-run.description: Build a read-only per-run findings page (dashboard/audit-runs/<id>.html) from the cloud store. Resolves --run <id> or .audit/last-audit-run.json.

dashboard:build.description: Build both dashboard pages (reference + telemetry) to dashboard/.

dashboard:setup.description: Bootstrap the dashboard: arch:refresh → arch:render → dashboard:build. Run after fresh clone, or after editing .audit-loop/domain-map.json.

db:adopt.description: Bootstrap audit_loop_migrations ledger by diffing live schema against tests/fixtures/expected-schema.json. Strict full-schema match required; manually apply outstanding migrations through the dashboard ONCE before running.

db:check-drift.description: Read-only drift check: source supabase/migrations/*.sql vs audit_loop_migrations ledger. Exit 0 clean, 1 drift, 2 hard error, 3 needs bootstrap. AUDIT_DB_URL-conditional.

db:check-drift:json.description: Drift check, JSON output for CI consumption (invoke `node` directly in CI, not via npm, to avoid npm log lines polluting stdout).

db:check-rls.description: List every public table without Row-Level Security enabled, plus anon/authenticated DML grants on those tables (= practical exposure on Supabase). Exit 0 clean / cloud-off, 1 findings, 2 connectivity error. AUDIT_DB_URL-conditional.

db:check-rls:gate.description: RLS check in GATE mode: blocks only on EXPLOITABLE exposure (a no-RLS table that also carries an anon/authenticated grant). A no-RLS table with no grants is advisory and does not block — ranking by exploitability, not lint level, so the gate cannot cry wolf. Wired into `npm run check`.

db:check-rls:json.description: RLS check, JSON output for CI consumption (invoke `node` directly in CI, not via npm, to avoid npm log lines polluting stdout).

db:local.description: Run the destructive DB integration suites locally against an ephemeral Docker Postgres (pgvector/pg16), mirroring the postgres-parity CI job. Requires Docker Desktop. See docs/runbooks/postgres-parity.md.

db:local:regen.description: Regenerate tests/fixtures/expected-schema.json locally against the same ephemeral Docker Postgres container as db:local.

db:migrate.description: Apply pending migrations (idempotent; skips already-applied via sha256). Requires AUDIT_DB_URL.

db:suites:gate.description: The gate form of db:local, wired into `npm run check`: runs the destructive DB suites against an ephemeral Docker Postgres so the DB seam is covered by the same gate as everything else. Blocks ONLY on a real suite/schema-diff failure (exit 1); a missing daemon, port clash, or concurrent container owner degrades to a loud skip that never implies coverage. AUDIT_LOOP_DB_TESTS_REQUIRED=1 promotes every skip to a hard failure; AUDIT_LOOP_DB_TESTS_SKIP=1 opts out (REQUIRED wins).

debt:budget.description: Check debt-ledger entry counts against per-path budgets (opt-in policy gate).

debt:health.description: Tech-debt ledger health — staleness, recurrence, budget violations (human report).

debt:review.description: Cluster accumulated tech-debt into ranked refactor candidates (local-only, no LLM call).

docs:check.description: Enforce docs/ root placement: root holds only allowlisted generated artefacts + live ledgers; hand-written docs belong in a bucket (reference/, runbooks/, plans/, research/). Runs as part of `npm run check`. Decision rule: docs/README.md.

docs:check:json.description: Machine-readable docs/ root placement report ({ok, checked, unexpected, staleAllowlistEntries}).

docs:refs.description: Reference-integrity gate: every cited repo path must resolve against the git index, or be marked a placeholder (docs/plans/<name>.md) or a forward-ref ((planned)). Report-only for now; gating lands with the plan's Phase 6. Contract: docs/reference/reference-integrity.md.

docs:refs:gate.description: The DRIFT-gate form of docs:refs (part of `npm run check`): fails only on a citation that NEWLY breaks — a GONE not in the accepted BASELINE — never on the standing total. A resolved baseline entry is stale and also fails (self-cleaning).

docs:refs:json.description: docs:refs as JSON — the citation census by class (RESOLVES/GONE/PLACEHOLDER/PLANNED) plus any scanner failures.

efficacy:check.description: Run the deterministic efficacy lints (cache-inertness, cache-instability, canary-no-test) — the GREEN≠REALIZED Cluster A check. Off by default; opt in via a committed efficacy-lints.config.json. Advisory in `npm run check` unless gate:true.

final-review:set.description: Persist the per-repo final-review provider (gemini | azure-claude | anthropic | default) to .env. Pass the provider as an arg: `npm run final-review:set -- azure-claude`. The work-repo lever for opting into Azure Foundry Opus.

gates:check.description: Validate every skill's gate-contract.json against its declared oracle + statedIn policy.

hooks:install.description: Install local pre-push hooks (skill-driven checks before push).

hooks:install:dry.description: Preview which hooks would be installed.

hooks:wire.description: Wire git at the tracked .githooks/ (same as prepare; run manually if hooks are not firing).

knip.description: knip drift-only report (--report mode) — shows net-new/stale findings without failing. Advisory diagnostic.

knip:baseline.description: Regenerate .knip-baseline.json to accept the CURRENT set of knip findings. Run after deliberately triaging/accepting a finding, never to silence one you have not looked at.

knip:exports.description: Full knip run including unused-exports/types — deliberately excluded from the gate (high volume, low precision; see knip-gate.mjs header). Run by hand when auditing dead exports.

knip:gate.description: knip drift-only pre-push gate (scripts/knip-gate.mjs). Fails ONLY on net-new dead-file/dependency/unresolved-import findings against the committed .knip-baseline.json — the pre-existing backlog never blocks a push. Part of npm run check.

learning:backfill-outcomes.description: Drain .audit/quickfix-hits.jsonl into learning_decisions + resolve outcomes from file state.

learning:quickfix-bootstrap.description: Rebuild quickfix stats from .audit/quickfix-hits.jsonl (for repos without cloud history).

learning:quickfix-rebuild.description: Rebuild the quickfix-pattern stats cache from cloud history.

learning:quickfix-stats.description: Print Beta posteriors per quickfix pattern (per repo).

learning:replay.description: Replay-evaluate a candidate policy against historical decisions (counterfactual).

learning:stats.description: Print learning-system counts (pending triage, no-brainers, stale deferrals).

learning:weekly-review.description: Generate the weekly learning digest + post the sticky GitHub issue.

maintenance:run.description: Local replica of the 5 weekly GH Actions maintenance checks (opt-in).

maintenance:status.description: Report the last local-maintenance run without running anything.

memory:health.description: Memory-health gate — fuzzy re-raise rate, cluster density, recurrence (human report).

models:check.description: Strict model-freshness gate (exits non-zero on stale IDs).

models:freshness.description: Check whether configured model IDs are still current with provider catalogs.

nav:audit.description: Static navigation / IA audit — system-level nav-graph lens; offered-vs-needed, drift-only CI gate.

npm-args.description: Census of documented `npm run <script> --flag` commands that omit the `--` separator, so npm swallows the flag before the script sees it. Report-only.

npm-args:gate.description: The DRIFT-gate form of npm-args (part of `npm run check`): fails only on a NET-NEW broken instruction in a live surface (plans/research/status.md excluded as records, not instructions). Origin: an AGENTS.md line omitted the `--` before a script flag, so npm consumed the flag and the sync ran unscoped, writing into every consumer repo instead of one.

on-conflict:all.description: Run the ON CONFLICT identity lint across the whole store (non-drift; diagnostic, high false-positive).

on-conflict:check.description: Lint scripts/lib/store for ON CONFLICT targets that disagree with a row's real identity (drift-only).

parity:check-coupling.description: Postgres-parity: check for schema coupling between non-core layers.

parity:check-refs.description: Postgres-parity: verify non-core code respects the schema boundary.

parity:check-refs:strict.description: Postgres-parity reference check, strict mode (CI gate).

parity:expected-schema.description: Postgres-parity: print the expected schema (drift baseline).

plans:index.description: Regenerates docs/plans/README.md — a status-bucketed index (Active / Superseded / Complete) of every plan. Makes the 150+-file plans directory navigable WITHOUT moving files, because a path is an identity and Status is a fact that changes; the docs/plans → docs/completed archiver was deleted for silently breaking inbound references (reference-integrity-gate.md Cluster C). Status parsing is delegated to lib/plan-status.mjs — nothing re-implements the parse.

plans:index:check.description: Fails if docs/plans/README.md is stale or missing — the freshness gate that makes the committed index a category-B generated artefact (deterministic, no clock/sha, byte-identical on regeneration). Runs in the pre-push check.

plans:lint.description: Static-check Mermaid blocks in docs/plans/*.md for the class of bugs GitHub renders leniently but VS Code preview rejects (e.g. subgraph IDs used as edge endpoints). Runs as part of `npm run check`.

plans:lint:json.description: plans:lint with machine-readable JSON output for CI.

plans:status.description: Vocabulary lint for plan Status lines: terminal Complete/Superseded · active Draft/Approved/In Progress. Rejects Implemented (ambiguous) + malformed/duplicate; a Status-less doc is not a plan (not a failure); *-audit-summary.md exempt. The single source of truth is scripts/lib/plan-status.mjs, which the pre-push hook also uses to select which plan to audit (--select).

plans:status:json.description: plans:status as JSON — the flagged non-conforming Status lines with reasons.

prepare.description: npm lifecycle — points core.hooksPath at the tracked .githooks/ so a fresh clone is gated on first install.

prepush:check.description: Run the check chain against a clean checkout of the commit being pushed (throwaway git worktree), so a concurrent session's working-tree edits cannot cause a false block or a false pass.

protect:main.description: Preview (dry-run) 'require branches up to date before merging' on a repo's existing main-branch ruleset — strengthen-only, auto-detects origin. Closes the stale-baseline ratchet failure class.

protect:main:apply.description: Apply 'require branches up to date before merging' to a repo's existing main-branch ruleset (never creates protection where none exists). Needs gh CLI + admin.

requirements:map:check.description: Fail if docs/requirements-map.md is stale against the ledger (Category-B freshness gate, in the pre-push check).

security:refresh.description: Refresh the security-incident memory from docs/security-strategy.md.

security:triage.description: Route SAST findings (SARIF 2.1.0) into review-priority buckets by deterministic predicates. Ingests --sarif <file>; never runs a scanner and never calls a model.

setup:cloud.description: Create or refresh ~/.audit-loop.env from the source repo's .env so consumer repos auto-inherit shared cloud config (DSN + LLM keys). Idempotent. --yes for CI, --dry-run to preview, --source-repo <path> to override discovery.

skills:check.description: Verify skill references are valid + mirrors are in sync.

skills:check-surface.description: Detect a stale .github/skills/ tree shadowing the live .claude/skills/ copies. Copilot Agent Skills reads both surfaces and .github/skills/ wins on a name collision, so a leftover copy silently intercepts the fresh one. Exits 1 on any shadowed name.

skills:fit-check.description: One-shot diagnostic: label each skill FITS / PARTIAL / MISMATCH for this repo's shape.

skills:help.description: Print all available skills + usage to stdout.

skills:regenerate.description: Regenerate .claude/skills/* mirrors from skills/* authoritative sources.

solo-control:catchup.description: Run the solo author-model control (Sonnet-5 + Fable-5 clean cold-diff) over new shadow commits — the code-audit null-hypothesis baseline. Incremental; self-gates on the arm-eval toggle.

solo-control:merge.description: Build the source-blinded, shuffled adjudication sheet merging solo-control findings with the ledger's A/B/C arms.

solo-control:score.description: Unblind the labeled solo-control sheet and report each arm's recall-of-apparatus-accepted / solo-only / apparatus-only.

sync.description: Sync this bundle into all registered consumer repos (auto-fires fit-check on first sync).

sync:check.description: Verify consumer repos are in lockstep with the source bundle.

sync:dry.description: Dry-run sync — preview what would be created/updated, no writes.

sync:path.description: Sync into ANY repo by path (append the directory) — no registry entry needed.

sync:refresh.description: Pull canonical then sync into one consumer (--target); shows its tracked changes. No commit/push.

sync:version-check.description: Compare consumer-repo audit-tool versions against the source manifest.

test.description: Run the full Node built-in test suite (everything under tests/).

test:db.description: Gated DB-integration tests (repo-identity stability + fragmentation guardrail). Requires a disposable AUDIT_DB_TEST_URL; skipped when unset. Never touches the live store.

upstream:issues.description: Triage worksheet for upstream bug reports filed from consumer repos (bundle staleness + prior fixes).
